buy_hold.note: Buy on first bar, hold to the end. Every candidate must beat this on risk-adjusted terms.

random_entry_atr_exits.note: Random entries (~2% of bars) with the Donchian strategy's ATR stop/TP. If a strategy barely beats this, its edge is the exit logic or luck.

ema_cross_trend.note: EMA fast>slow cross while close>EMA trend; exit on cross down; ATR trailing stop.

donchian_turtle.note: Enter on close above previous N-bar high; exit on close below previous M-bar low; 2-ATR stop.

macd_trend.note: MACD line crosses above signal while close>EMA trend; exit cross below; ATR stop.

tsmom_30d.note: Long when the trailing N-day return is positive, evaluated once a day at 00:00 UTC; exit when negative. Wide disaster stop only.

tsmom_vote.source: TSMOM multi-horizon vote (Moskowitz et al.; Hurst, Ooi, Pedersen 2017)
tsmom_vote.note: Long when the trailing return is positive on ALL listed horizons (days), evaluated once a day; exit when any turns negative. Disaster stop only.

tsmom_trail.note: Daily TSMOM entry/exit plus a trailing stop from the high-water mark to cap give-back.

tsmom_ema_filter.source: TSMOM with long-term EMA regime filter
tsmom_ema_filter.note: Daily TSMOM, but only long while close is above a long EMA (regime filter); exit when momentum turns negative or close drops below the EMA.

supertrend_consensus.note: Three Supertrends (periods 7/10/14) all up -> enter; all down -> exit. Original uses stoploss -10%.

ft_adx_smas.note: ADX>25 & SMA3 crosses above SMA6 -> enter; ADX<25 & SMA6 crosses above SMA3 -> exit; stoploss -25%, minimal_roi 10%.

ft_strategy001.note: EMA20 crosses above EMA50 & HA close>EMA20 & HA open<HA close -> enter; EMA50 crosses below EMA100 & HA close<EMA20 & HA open>HA close -> exit; minimal_roi {60m:1%,30m:3%,20m:4%,0:5%} (scaled), stoploss -10%.

bb_rsi_meanrev_stop.note: RSI<thr and re-entry above lower BB -> enter; exit RSI>55 or BB mid; stop and time stop.

ft_bbandrsi.note: RSI(14)<30 & close<BB(20,2) lower -> enter; exit RSI>70; minimal_roi 10%; stoploss -25%. ROI-vs-stop asymmetry = high win rate, hidden tail.
